title: Getting the paperwork off the truck
industry: Any crew that leaves the building
blurb: What the crew writes down, and everything that happens to it afterwards.
asks: What does the crew write down out there, and how does it get back to you?
sample:
Text from Marco, 4:52pm:

done at 720 Fourth St. replaced the contactor, part CB-330. 2.5 hrs. customer signed. they asked about the second unit, said call em monday 912-555-0117. also need 3 ea of the same contactor on the truck

steps.name: It gets back to the office
steps.note: Sometimes Friday. Sometimes not at all.

steps.name: Work out what parts got used
Anything the crew flagged gets followed up
steps.note: The 'they asked about the second unit' line — that's revenue, and it's the bit that gets lost.
